ops.parking: The hotel has a parking facility with 250 spaces. The maximum parking space size is 5.8 m long, 1.9 m wide and 2.2 m high. The regular rate is 300 yen per 30 minutes; for hotel guests, 3,000 yen per 24 hours (4,000 yen with valet service). Discounts apply with restaurant use (1 hour free for 3,000 to under 5,000 yen, 2 hours free for 5,000 to under 10,000 yen, 4 hours free for 10,000 yen or more). If the lot is full, use a parking lot outside the hotel. There are no EV charging facilities for guests.
ops.waitingRooms: The small banquet halls (Momiji 35㎡, Tsubaki 35㎡, Satsuki 24㎡, Annex 1F) are introduced as ideal rooms for meetings and waiting rooms. They can also be used together with the adjacent small banquet hall as one continuous room.
ops.catering: The hotel offers a catering service (from 30 people, about 30,000 to 40,000 yen per person, including buffet dishes, drinks and a full set of catering equipment; for the 23 wards of Tokyo). The application deadline is 2 weeks before the date of use. A quote is made after a site survey, and depending on the venue it may be difficult to accommodate. The "Meeting Package" for meeting rooms is 31,130 yen per person for 1 day (8 hours) and 18,480 yen per person for a half day (4 hours) (minimum 10 people, tax and service charge included, bookable from 2 months before the event date).
ops.restaurants: The hotel's restaurants officially introduced are Collage, China Blue, Kazahana, Cerise and TWENTY EIGHT.
